network.name: phase10-wallet-lab
network.topology: two portable Magpie nodes on one host/LAN, loopback/LAN EasyTier no-TUN; not WAN

bFlow.consumerRequest: no-file request sent from 发现
bFlow.delivery: encrypted delivery pulled; consumer native Remote registered; provider shows acked; consumer shows connected=1

paymentFlow.providerSide: no provider payment request; no terms; no invoice; no signature; no send
observed: The provider and consumer EasyTier peers are connected (1 peer, direct).
The provider's catalogue/presence is reachable via the consumer SOCKS5 and via a raw socksHttpGet (200, 1822 bytes).

The consumer's directory refresh sometimes reports 'catalogue read timed out after 5000ms' while a direct raw SOCKS read from the same host succeeds; after setting both nodes to catalogue port 3426 the peer read succeeded.
After the payment request the provider's plugin host restarted repeatedly (boot log every ~5-10 s); the provider payment state stayed empty. Root cause not established in this lab.
paymentFlow.conclusion: The C payment protocol/store/service and the B payment_message hook are covered by unit/integration tests, but a real end-to-end P2P payment is NOT claimed. The no-file authorization/approval/delivery part is real.
